description: Rehearsal 6 scope changes to baseline BL-CAUSA-INDY-INIT-856157a78d47 (requirements/causa-requirements-baseline-r6.json). Each change applies one owner decision in kickoff/rehearsal-006/owner-decisions.json. Every change below was transcribed by an agent on the owner's instruction; the owner did not edit this file. Under RDP-003 they take effect only when the owner merges the pull request that adds this file.

provenance.recordedBy: agent (Claude Code), on the owner's instruction
provenance.ownerWords: Do what you recommend to get it started
provenance.effective: on the owner's merge of the pull request that adds this file (RDP-003)

changes.criterion: Never expose credentials. Application-level role management does not apply to Causa's approved single-user scope. Credential protection, authorization of every repository operation against the provider's actual permissions, workspace data isolation and secure handling of operational information still apply and must be verified.
changes.rationale: DEC-R6-003, option A. Causa is a single-user browser application with no user roles, so a role model would be invented scope. The obligation's credential clause is unchanged, and authentication, authorization and isolation are kept explicitly, because a single-user application is not exempt from them.

changes.criterion: Original Rehearsal 3 must yield an authoritative non-accepting verdict (INVALID, FAIL or BLOCKED), and the report must state the exact verdict and its diagnostic classification without merging INVALID, FAIL and BLOCKED into one outcome; Rehearsal 2 candidate 45644a7 should yield ACCEPTED only if its actual ledger and evidence meet the frozen contract.
changes.rationale: DEC-R6-004, option A. The safety property is that the original Rehearsal 3 is never accepted. The verifier refuses it as INVALID or FAIL, which are stronger refusals than BLOCKED. AR-007-O2 and AR-018-O1, which keep the verdict categories distinct, are unchanged.
